question: A television station telecasts three types of programs $X$, $Y$ and $Z$. A survey gives the following data on television viewing. Among the people interviewed 60% watch program $X$, 50% watch program $Y$, 50% watch program $Z$, 30% watch programs $X$ and $Y$, 20% watch programs $Y$ and $Z$, 30% watch programs $X$ and $Z$ while 10% do not watch any television program.
